terminology.extractor: Second LLM call that extracts a short final answer.
terminology.test_acc: Fraction of correct answers on test split.
terminology.test_parsed: Proxy parse-success rate on test split (1 - parse_failures / total).

evaluation_note: Standalone vLLM evaluator for internal fair comparison. Describe as GreaTer-compatible baseline re-evaluation, not exact reproduction.

hyperbaton.Meta-01: Identify the sentence with the adjective order that follows the typical English language pattern of modifying nouns in a specific order.
hyperbaton.Meta-02: Modify the sentence to adhere to the typical adjective order in English, prioritizing descriptive words in the following sequence: opinion, size, shape, color, nationality, material, and finally action or state.
hyperbaton.Meta-03: Identify the sentence with the most logical and intuitive adjective order.
hyperbaton.Meta-04: Arrange the adjectives in each sentence in the order of English language precedence.
hyperbaton.Meta-05: Modify the adjective to its corresponding noun to determine the correct adjective order in a sentence.
hyperbaton.Meta-06: Determine the correct adjective order by placing the most specific descriptors closest to the noun they modify.
hyperbaton.Meta-07: Modify the sentence by rearranging the adjectives to follow the typical English word order: adjective-noun.
hyperbaton.Meta-08: Arrange the adjectives in each sentence to follow the typical English adjective order of size, color, material, origin, and other descriptors.
hyperbaton.Meta-09: Identify the sentence with the correct adjective order, following the standard English word order of attributive adjectives, from most general to most specific.
hyperbaton.Meta-10: Modify the sentence to follow the typical order of adjectives in English, typically from most general to most specific.
